about: Ben's WIP limit (G, 4 Nov 2026: 'yes to E, F, G'; raised to 8 the same evening for two OWB longs a week). At most `limit` films are in production (topic to Ben's watch) at once. A film leaves `active` when it reaches Ben's watch (UAT); the first film in `next` then enters through one topic go/no-go review (AGENTS.md rule E) and its work is queued. Shorts and Studio finishing on uploaded films don't count. Per channel (5 Nov 2026, Ben: 'we've almost run out of history of science'): OWB 5 and HOS 4 places; a film that leaves is replaced from its own channel's line (`next` for OWB, `next_hos` for HOS). Before this, `next` held only OWB films, so every HOS place that freed up went to OWB.
entered_note: Date each film entered active, for the days-to-Ben's-watch speed tile (target 14). The first six are counted from the WIP start, 4 Nov 2026.
